regions.today: Outbreaks of rain and drizzle this evening, possibly heavy in places, before turning patchy later. Turning milder and breezier towards nightfall.
regions.tonight: Mostly cloudy, breezy and mild tonight, with patchy outbreaks of rain and drizzle turning more persistent from the northwest later in the night. Lows of 12 to 15 degrees in moderate to fresh southwesterly winds, will become westerly overnight.
regions.tomorrow: Dull and wet for many areas to begin tomorrow, Friday. Rain will gradually clear southeastwards through the morning, followed by brighter, fresher conditions with sunny spells and scattered showers. Breezy with afternoon highs of 11 to 14 degrees in moderate to fresh and gusty westerly winds.
